selection_basis: Frozen nonexpert-v1 development screen only; no HumanEval+ used for selection.

rationale.A: 21/24 equals MXFP4; 27.3% more generation time and larger weights.
rationale.B: 14/24 versus MXFP4 21/24; nine truncations; no useful-speed gain.
rationale.C: 22/24 versus MXFP4 21/24; two paired gains, one loss, descriptive exact McNemar p=1.0; 23.7% more generation time, 18.4% more tokens and 9.9% more weight bytes.

next_action: One controlled follow-up: retain C as the control and reduce only affine 4-bit expert down-projection group size from 64 to 32; keep other precision unchanged and compare against pinned MXFP4.
next_action_status: Recommended only; not implemented or run. Smaller groups target expert quantization granularity; evidence here does not identify the cause of excessive completion lengths.
